notes.title: New Test Patch on Beta Branch
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Thanks for your patience since our last update.  We've been hard at work doing some optimization and multiplayer bug squashing.  We just uploaded our next test patch to the beta branch and would love to get some feedback.

Here are the areas of focus.

Optimization - We've gone through and compelted a major optimization pass on all of our games textures.  We've pulled nearly 2GB...yes, that's GB, of texture memory out of some of the neighbohoods and reduced the entire game install size by about 1.5GB.  This will hopefully help with some loading times for some systems.

Multiplayer Bugs - We focused on multiplayer bugs relating to the van in this patch.  Most of the user videos we've seen, as entertaining as they were, showed bugs relating to entering and exiting the van.  We have reworked the van passenger code and it should hopefully be a much more stable experience now as you're getting in and out.

Please try it out and let us know what you think and if you encounter any issues.  As always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.14 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

We just posted another patch a few hours ago.  This patch features some more van improvements with a brand new re-designed dash.

The new dash, aside from looking a whole lot better, will also now dynamically update for things such as your tuned radio station, dash light brightness depending on your headlights or high beams, engine trouble indicators for less than stellar driving, door open/close states, a working speedometer and animated shifter.

We also fixed raindrop particles disappearing when entering the van during a storm.

We'll also be improving the cop car dash in preparation for our cops vs robbers multiplayer game mode in a future patch.

We hope you enjoy the additional van improvements!

notes.title: Klepto 0.1.13 Patch
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23037914/44ae86113029452596d2dc55d884bdecc491beb9.jpg[/img]

Hey Kleptomaniacs!

We've just posted our latest patch. This includes an updated game engine so it will be a full download for you this time.  Here's what's inside:

-new game engine, this includes optimized netcode which eliminates replication calls for unchanged data, this means less traffic being transmitted and better performance

-improved virtual cursor in desktop main menu and in game tablet, the cursor is now contained within the screen and you won't see a floating cursor that extends beyond the screen or tablet

-van roll prevention, it is no longer possible for the van to roll over and remain on its side or upside-down, it will now roll back and correct itself

-direct x 10 support has been added

-the game can now launch outside of the steam client and still connect to the steam api

That's all for now.  Our work continues on the new cops vs robbers multiplayer game mode and the first part of our 0.2.0 release!

notes.title: Dev Blog - 01.02.17
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/SjEHEMT.png]

Happy New Year Kleptomaniacs!

We hope the holiday has treated you well and you've been enjoying the steam winter sale.  Now that vacations are ending and we're getting back into the swing of things we thought it would be the perfect time you give you an update of where things are with Klepto.

We're still hard at work getting ready for our alpha 0.2.0 release.  It hasn't gone as fast as we hoped but we are making steady progress.  Our Oldtown redesign is just about done and our core gameplay for the cops vs robbers game mode is in place.  Right now we are working out our scoring system and our functionality on the different ways we'll be ending a multiplayer round.

Our level designer Apothis has taken the jump into mansion design for our high-end neighborhood!  This won't be in the initial 0.2.0 update but work has begun for this neighborhood.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/spZZTjh.png]
[img=http://i.imgur.com/k8MinRt.png]
[img=http://i.imgur.com/gArBRo6.png]

Our 3D artist Alex has also been hard at work on designing the inside of our van.  He's has started on tiered upgrades for the back of the van and will also be redesigning the dash so you'll have something more pleasing to look at while cruising around the neighborhood.  The upgrades to the van will include addition hacking equipment and RF upgrades for wifi attacks.  Here's a preview of the tier 1 upgrade minus some of the computer equipment.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/crmq98T.png]
[img=http://i.imgur.com/PTFv3TQ.png]
[img=http://i.imgur.com/JeSEBZi.png]

Finally, as for our next patch, we are planning to upgrade to the latest version of the Unreal Engine.  This will also provide some 3D mouse cursor fixes we have been patiently waiting for as well was improvements and optimizations to network code for multiplayer.

Thanks for your continued support and we look forward to bringing you more updates soon!

notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WaTV074.jpg[/img]

Alpha 0.1.11 is now available!

[b]General[/b]

This is a minor update containing the new house LODs for Murky Meadows (Fragbound Farms is still in progress). For the further LODs, these changes include a new single material low-poly version of houses to help reduce the amount of draw calls for better CPU optimization. 

[i]Before[/i]
[url=http://i.imgur.com/Oc3tOJQ.jpg][img]http://i.imgur.com/Oc3tOJQ.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]After[/i]
[url=http://i.imgur.com/KXgdcvd.jpg][img]http://i.imgur.com/KXgdcvd.jpg[/img][/url]


For the closer LODs we've added the new parallax effect window materials. We've also moved the porch lights and mailboxes into the persistent level so these items will no longer "pop in" when house interiors are loaded.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/LqV7NTz.gif[/img]

We've also increased render distances and foliage LOD distances for the "Epic" graphics setting for render quality. This visual improvement may have a negative impact to your system's performance. This change can also be toggled using the Numpad +/- keys. 

[b]Multiplayer[/b]

We've added some error messages to the main menu to display multiplayer session failures. We're currently investigating the known issue of initial join attempts resulting in a Connection Timeout error.

notes.title: Dev Blog 10.26.2016
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Gj7YgbE.jpg[/img]

[h1]Alpha 0.1.x[/h1]

As mentioned in the recent [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/403590/announcements/detail/892102442756410087]Alpha 0.1.10 Patch Notes[/url] we’ll be scaling down on the weekly patch activity for the next few weeks as we put a greater amount of focus in finishing up everything for Alpha 0.2.0. However, game breaking bugs will always have our top priority so be sure to continue reporting these on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/403590/discussions/1/]Bug Tracker[/url].

Alpha 0.1.11 will likely be released sometime next week. This will contain some of the house rendering improvements detailed below along with some new error handling logic to aid us in investigating some multiplayer session join failures that seem to frequently occur during an initial join attempt. 

[h1]Rendering Improvements[/h1]

In a continued effort to improve the transition between level streaming volumes used to contain all of our house interiors, Nate has created a fantastic 2D texture with a parallax effect making it appear 3D to replace the current reflective window materials on the low-poly houses when interiors are not being rendered.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/LqV7NTz.gif[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Jhqu0cY.jpg[/img]

We’re also in the process of testing increased distances to populate house interiors from further away. This will further reduce the remaining “pop-in”.

Speaking of LODs...

[h1]Simplygon Integration[/h1]

[url=https://www.unrealengine.com/blog/simplygon-introduces-free-indie-license-and-ships-with-ue4-installer]Simplygon Indie License Announcement[/url]

We we’re excited to find out this week that Simplygon, the industry-leading 3D modelling optimization platform used by a majority of the AAA studios for generating LODs has opened up their platform to indie developers like us. We’ve wasted no time at all in getting started with this SDK. In the short-term, we’ll be using this to generate LODs for all of the current assets. This will help reduce any GPU bottlenecking. 

Although the project does already have a lot of LOD states for various assets, the previous process for us to do so has been quite time consuming with mixed results in quality using the tools our limited budget could afford. 

In the long-term, we’ll be able to bring in new lootable assets containing greater modeling detail and increased polycounts to allow closer inspection of these assets in game. VR players will benefit from that added detail the most most when we add in additional item interaction/inspection to the motion controls by attaching the loot to your hand first rather than automatically place into inventory. 

Here’s Simplygon in action with our main thief skeletal mesh starting at the original LOD0 of 34K and smoothly scaling down to 2K. The poly count is in the upper left corner. Generating these new LODs took grand total of 10 seconds. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VQL2uCV.gif[/img]

[url=http://i.imgur.com/VQL2uCV.gifv]GIFV version[/url]

[h1]Alpha 0.2.0[/h1]

As mentioned earlier, the team has been hard at work on the Alpha 0.2.0 update. Most recently, we’ve been working on the new multiplayer gamemode, Cops & Robbers. The new lobby level is almost finished. 

Briefing Room (Cop Team)
[img]http://i.imgur.com/dRYpvpO.png[/img]

Alleyway (Thief Team)
[img]http://i.imgur.com/YlWUQ8E.png[/img]

We’re currently experimenting with some voice chat mechanics with some associated equipment upgrades to increase communication distance and stealth against both opposing players and NPC residents. 

We’ve also got the stun-baton usage finished up. Excessive force is quite satisfying :) 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qNmSRL4.gif[/img]

[h1]Feedback[/h1]

As always, please keep the feedback coming. We are always reading the forum posts and replying as frequently as possible. Be sure to let us know about any issues you’re having and continue sharing your suggestions!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/EJ7V2St.png[/img]

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.8 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QSCa9J3.jpg[/img]

Alpha 0.1.8 is now available! This has been a really busy week for us following the release of 0.1.7. Since that last update, we’ve migrated the project over to Unreal Engine 4.13 to take advantage of all the great improvements, fixes and features added to the engine. 

Unfortunately, this migration broke most of our UI interaction due to the new method Epic has implemented for 3D widget interactions. While we have things functional again, there’s still a lot of work and polish remaining. 

We’ve also added the much requested fence climbing ability! At the moment, this feature is currently only supported in Murky Meadows. To climb simply press the jump button while facing the fence. This feature is still in its infancy and pretty experimental so you may run into a few quarks. We also intend on improving these animations in a future update. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6lIyTK7.gif[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Migrated project to UE 4.13
[*]Added fence climbing - This feature is currently “experimental” 
[*]Vive locomotion changes (see “Vive Changes” below)
[*]Fixed textures for Telco Box 
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Friends List added to Main Menu laptop. This should display any friends currently playing Klepto. Click their name to automatically join their session - This feature is currently “experimental” 
[*]Time of day selection has been fixed
[*]LAN connections are now supported in Co-op game mode. Local co-op game mode has been removed.
[*]Players should now spawn at the same starting location
[*]Vehicle damage now in sync between players
[/list]

[h1]Vive Changes[/h1]

Although the full Vive support still isn’t scheduled to be completed until Alpha 0.2.0, we’re going to be incorporating these changes with our weekly(ish) patches to get some early feedback. Today’s patch includes the first pass at the new locomotion controls. For those of you who’ve played Onward, you should find this somewhat familiar. 

Alpha 0.1.8 currently defaults to room-scale with motion controls when Vive is detected. Next week’s patch will include an option to play seated with gamepad. 

Locomotion is controlled with the left motion controller. 

[list]
[*]Touch the top/bottom of the trackpad to move forward/backward
[*]Left/right to strafe in those directions
[*]To rotate, physically turn in the direction you want to move. The rotation is based on the forward vector of the left motion controller to allow the head look to remain decoupled from character rotation. 
[*]Press and hold top of trackpad to “sprint” - Please send us your feedback on both walk and “sprint” speeds. 
[*]Press bottom of trackpad to reset HMD position/orientation
[*]Left trigger to interact
[/list]

To break windows, switch to the crowbar and swing at the glass. Please be careful, I left a bit of a dent in the wall yesterday while testing this...

[b]Vive Known Issues:[/b]

[list]
[*]Rotating causes hands to drift from controls - Fix coming in 0.1.9
[*]Hands are creepy (my option) - Reducing their scale in 0.1.9
[*]Multiplayer not supported for multiple Vive users due to motion controller replication issues - Fix coming in 0.2.0
[*]Desktop/Tablet interaction limited to gaze control of cursor - Motion controls as input pointer coming in 0.1.9
[*]Desktop/Tablet cursor scale too large - Partial fix coming in 0.1.9. Full fix coming as we finish updating this based on recent UE4 engine changes
[*]Interactions not fully setup - Full motion control support coming in 0.2.0 but we will continue adding new interactions as they are ready. Next week’s update will include new loot interactions to pick-up and inspect items rather than automatically placing them in your inventory.
[/list]

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]

Due to the UI interaction impact from the UE 4.13 migration, I’ve had to push back the dev blog update on the Hacking v1.0 mechanics. I will be diving back into this work very soon. Until then, here’s a tease of the “Fences 9” operating system you’ll be able to interact with in homes across Klepto.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/e2j0fdR.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dev Blog: New Oldtown
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/L3FPzaD.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the new Oldtown. We’re in the process of a full redesign of our city center where players will encounter a majority of their mission contacts and fences for their ill gotten gains. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QMBMyiL.jpg[/img]


[img]http://i.imgur.com/JEE23RN.png[/img]


[img]http://i.imgur.com/0rPDjfx.png[/img]

This will be a part of the upcoming Alpha 0.2.0 content update. There’s still a lot of work to do but we’d like to share our current progress.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/DHExHpK.png[/img]

[b]Mr. Castellano’s Pawn Shop

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Y95OMNZ.png[/img]

rePRO Joe’s Garage

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QxqG9fp.png[/img]

Happy Cleaners

[img]http://i.imgur.com/NfBI2RN.png[/img]

Dr. Dover’s Family Practice

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IQ4R1EC.png[/img]

Hastings Gallery[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fIyabX1.png[/img]

[b]Cops & Robbers[/b]

In addition to being a key location for our mission system, we’re also setting up the end of level scenes for the upcoming Cops & Robbers multiplayer. When the Cops are on the losing team, they’ll find themselves reflecting on their mistakes at Joey’s Bag of Donuts while they see the other team slipping into Mr. Castellano’s Pawn Shop to offload their goods.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KwDKEBX.png[/img]

However, if they are victorious they’ll end the level inside the police station with the Robbers locked away in a holding cell. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/gbVl2PP.png[/img]

Unfortunately, they have one of the best lawyers in town so don’t expect them to sit around too long. They’ll be back on the streets in no time. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/2ulgJEd.png[/img]

[b]Post-Alpha 0.2.0 Plans[/b]

Like the current version of Oldtown, the new Oldtown of Alpha 0.2.0 will have the robbery mechanics disabled. However, all of the buildings (excluding the low poly ones that surround Oldtown) are setup in a way where we can build out their interiors. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3eFCMmQ.png[/img]

It’s our goal to eventually expand residential burglary to Oldtown by building out all of the interiors for the various apartment buildings. However, we still don’t have any plans of supporting commercial robbery in the release scope. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hDLu32k.png[/img]

Be sure to check back for next week’s Dev Blog detailing the upcoming hacking mechanics being introduced in Alpha 0.2.0!

notes.title: Dev Blog: Mission System v1.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ji3KRBp.jpg[/img]

[h1]Intro[/h1]

A major feature being added to the upcoming Alpha 0.2.0 release is Mission System v1.0. This includes a variety of mission types, some unique one-shot-only missions, reputation system and more.

[h1]Garrett’s List[/h1]

Garrett’s List is the primary source for obtaining missions. The primary interface is accessed via the klept_os desktop before entering a neighborhood. Once you’ve accepted a contract, there’s no backing out. Your reputation is on the line.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bTVOfHf.png[/img]

Be cautious of the contracts you accept, especially if the contact is using a new account on Garrett’s List. You never know when it might be a police sting...

Once inside a neighborhood, you can use the Garrett’s List companion app on your klept_os Mobile to track your mission objectives.

[h1]Reputation[/h1]

Reputation is gained from the successful completion of contracts on Garrett’s List. This includes an overall community reputation and contact specific reputation. Failing contracts can negatively impact your rep resulting in lower payouts and lower-tiered missions being available.

[h1]Contract Completion[/h1]

Completing a contract often involve a physical exchange of an item. Sometimes this is a face-to-face, other times it's via a dead drop location. A waypoint for the destination will be available on the map when players exit the neighborhood.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/09U8cv5.png[/img]

[h1]Mission Types[/h1]

Here’s a breakdown of some planned mission categories included in Mission System v1.0:

[b]Car Repo[/b]

We’ve just added a vehicle damage system to the internal build. The new repo missions will require delivery of an undamaged vehicle for full payout. Delivering a highly damaged vehicle will likely result in negative reputation with the mission contact.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Je1Bze8.png[/img]

[b]Happy Cleaners[/b]

Keep an eye out for unclaimed dry cleaning tickets. Stealing these tickets and returning them to Mr. Wong at Happy Cleaners in Oldtown will unlock the corresponding cosmetic item for purchase. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9nzqC3P.png[/img]

[b]Data Theft[/b]

This missions typically involve locating and obtaining digital assets from a residents computer. Easier missions can be completed by stealing and delivering the entire computer while others rely on leaving no evidence behind by gaining access to the computer locally (or remotely with Hacking v2.0) and copying the files to your thumbdrive.

Fortunately, a majority of the residents are still running older versions of the Fences operating system. More details on this with the upcoming Hacking v1.0 article.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0lRuafK.jpg[/img]


[b]Vandalism[/b]

Sure, stealing is financially rewarding but smashing things is so much more satisfying. These missions involve inflicting physical damage to the target assets. 

[b]Newspaper reDelivery[/b]

Being a startup company for dying media can be tough and expensive but not when your competition is offsetting the expenses. ReDelivery missions involve stealing newspapers from subscribers of the big evil newspaper conglomerate and redelivering them to the more cost-concerned subscribers of reDelivery.

[b]Item Theft[/b]

I shouldn’t have to explain this one to any reputable burglar. Someone wants something specific and it’s not for you to ask why. However, these missions may sometimes present some ethical dilemmas for the player.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/LusTcCM.png[/img]

[b]Blackmail[/b]

Yes, I know it may be counter intuitive for you to break into a home and leave items rather than take them but I assure you, it’s for the greater good (for someone). These missions will vary between digital and physical evidence being planted with future plans to expand this category to also include obtaining photos of incriminating activities.   

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Lk0Ou68.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Blog 08.29.2016
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/r30LwCHl.jpg[/img]

[b]Alpha 0.1.5[/b]

This week's patch was primarily focused around the police AI. We've improved how the AI cop cars detect suspects (players with an elevated alert level). We've also resolved the "Running Man" dance caused by the arrest sequence occurring while the player was mid-run. Additionally, we've reworked the pathing for AI vehicles. As always, we've also updated Fragbound Farms with additional houses populated. 

[b]Alpha 0.2.0 Progress[/b]

In addition to the continued fixes and improvements to Alpha 0.1, the team has been hard at work on all of the features being packed into our first major content release, Alpha 0.2.0. This release remains on schedule to be delivered in Q4. 

[i]Multiplayer: Cops & Robbers[/i] 

Excessive force has never been so much fun! The Stun-o-matic 9000 is the latest in nerve twitching, somewhat less-than-lethal, tools of behavioral modification. Wield corrective action at a bladder alleviating 7.8M volts longer than ever before with the newly redesigned nickel-metal hydride (NI-MH) battery standard in all models. Call your authorized reseller today to schedule a test prodding. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3q5XzL8.gif[/img]

[i]Mission System v1.0[/i]

The updated mission system framework has been one of my main priorities. Rather than trying to summarize this feature in a short paragraph, I'll be writing a dedicated dev blog post next week to cover all the details of "Garret's List" aka Mission System v1.0 coming in Alpha 2.0. Be sure to check back! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Lk0Ou68l.png[/img]

[i]Hacking v1.0[/i]

New toys arrived! I've been diving deeper into RF hacking in the real-world to ensure our hacking mechanics remain as realistic as possible. I spent some time over the weekend reverse engineering the RF signals from my car's key fob and garage door opener in an attempt at some replay attacks I have planned for Hacking v1.0 in Klepto. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hxMFgtBl.jpg[/img]

As I have planned for the Mission System next week, in a couple of weeks I'll be writing a dedicated dev blog post to dive deeper into the Alpha 2.0 hacking mechanics. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cclkXx0l.png[/img]

[i]klept_os Mobile v2.0[/i]

Both the mission system and hacking gameplay along with the upcoming Cops and Robbers multiplayer game mode rely heavily on the players klept_os tablet. Because of this, a lot of work is going into redesigning and expanding upon its functionality and ease of interaction. Some of the changes include a GPS/Maps app to help you navigate the neighborhoods. Additionally, we're working on full touch interaction for HTC Vive and Oculus Touch controllers.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9DwD5JWl.png[/img]

Be sure to check out the upcoming dev blog posts on the Mission System v2.0 and Hacking v1.0 for more details on the upcoming tablet changes. 

[i]Inventory v2.0[/i]

With the upcoming Mission System v1.0 and klept_os Mobile 2.0 changes, we're reworking several aspects of the inventory / loot management. We'll be updating the current placeholder loot values with more realistic prices. Although food items will no longer have a monetary value, we do have some special plans for these items. 

[i]Safe Cracking v2.0[/i]

Safe cracking is getting a major overhaul to include all new types of safes with varying levels of difficulty. While we still intend on these being very difficult to crack, at least without the in-game purchase of specialized tools, certain safes will have unique weaknesses making them easier to crack.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nhnUk2nl.jpg[/img]

[b]Post-Alpha 2.0[/b]

Although there's still a lot of work remaining to finish Fragbound Farms, Apothis, our lead level designer has created some new luxury townhomes to be used in our next neighborhood. Here's an early look.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/eLwIhfll.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Now Available on Early Access!
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/403590/][img]http://i.imgur.com/w7At6Fjl.jpg[/img][/url]

Klepto has officially launched as Early Access with our Alpha 0.1.0 release. It will be available at a discounted launch sale price of $9.74 until July 7th. Purchasing during Early Access will also unlock the following two items:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MSgZYDzl.png[/img]

Show off your early support of the game by sporting the exclusive skin, the prison stripe Founder's backpack in Klepto's online multiplayer. 

Delivery Details: This cosmetic item will be wearable by players online in a future content update bringing multiplayer customization and reward unlocks to the online gameplay. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/axNAYbll.png[/img]

Kick off your hacking career in style with the Founder's Edition Zeus 2000f Laptop featuring LED color selection and a 10% speed upgrade* 

Delivery Details: This in-game item will be available to players in a future content update bringing new hacking equipment and vehicle customization. 

* 10% speed is in comparison to default starting laptop.

[b]Game Updates[/b]

We are planning weekly patches for fixes and minor content updates/improvements. In addition to the minor content updates, we’ll be posting larger content and feature updates on a monthly basis as these new features are completed. Be sure to cast your votes on the [url=https://trello.com/b/bw8DJ0C7/klepto-early-access-roadmap]Trello Early Access Roadmap[/url] to help us determine which of these upcoming features you're most interested in seeing implemented first.

[b]Issue Reporting[/b]

We’ve setup a subforum on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/403590/discussions/1/]Steam Community[/url] discussion board to report new issues. We will open a Jira (internal bug tracking tool) ticket for new issues and include the ticket number in our response. 

We will then post cards of these tickets on the [url=https://trello.com/b/bw8DJ0C7/klepto-early-access-roadmap]Trello Early Access Roadmap[/url] under the Bug Tracking list. Be sure to cast your vote on these cards if you are also impacted by one of these open issues.

[b]VR Support[/b]

We are planning to release an update next week that includes several VR specific options to customize from the main menu including graphical settings and default locomotion options. 

Supporting both VR and non-VR gameplay presents us with a difficult decision regarding tradeoffs. We don't want a visual reduction in quality to impact non-VR players who are not impacted by the massive rendering overhead of VR but at the same time, we want to make sure our VR players enjoy the same level of gameplay.

Our VR implementation still needs quite a bit of work on both an optimization perspective and overall controls. Keep the feedback coming on the VR subforum. We’ve got a lot of improvements in the works, much of which has been based on feedback we’ve seen so far.

notes.title: Klepto Development Blog 05/03/2016
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cnpV88Y.png[/img]

Welcome back to Klepto and our monthly development blog update!

The recent release of our demo has caused a bit of controversy. Some may think that we put our demo out too early, but we wanted that early feedback to make sure we were going down the right road. We definitely want to give a BIG THANKS to the community for their initial feedback, harsh though some of it may have been. We do take ALL feedback seriously – as an example, we’ve revamped our Vive controls based on user feedback. We want to assure everyone that we’ll be updating the Klepto demo with new fixes and features as we progress, so please keep that feedback coming!

We’re getting ever closer to Early Access release, although our release timeline has been pushed back a few weeks to give us more time to finish things up. We’re currently targeting the end of May. Please be patient… Klepto is on its way!


[h1]VR Improvements[/h1]

- Our electrician has changed out the light bulbs on our tutorial level resulting is a more optimized and better lit experience.

- We’ve added an optional “comfort travel system” in VR for those who are more easily affected by VR-induced motion sickness.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SNjVbbf.gif[/img]

- We’ve re-worked the motion controls and have added visible VR hands.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7DCvscYUxTY>

- You can now rummage through drawers and break windows all with the motion controls. We’ll be adding full tablet touch control next.

- A second demo hotfix is coming soon with VR updates.


[h1]0.0.4 Beta and Early Access Progress[/h1]

- Matt is hip-deep in the new mission system. More on that coming soon…

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5QNmJU7.png[/img]

- Preparations for multiplayer continue. We are redesigning the multiplayer lobby and are working on some client/server replication issues.

- We’ve made TONS of progress on Murkly Meadows! Kershaw Drive houses are complete and work on other streets has been started. New residents need to be moved in, but houses are furnished and are ready to be explored.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/DnWuRgx.png[/img]

- Fragbound Farms is well underway and houses are being staged.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xQQqq5o.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6dSCGiI.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/B4AFyIN.png[/img]


That's about it for this month's Klepto updates. We're looking forward to seeing everyone's reactions once the Beta goes live. Keep both eyes peeled for more news about that and other developments. Until next time, keep to the shadows!
